categories.name: Tenant and owner isolation

strengths.title: Invoice handler rejects cross-tenant input before returning
strengths.description: Within the visible handler, unequal invoice and principal tenant identifiers raise PermissionError before the invoice return. This is a static control observation conditional on trusted principal and invoice attributes; runtime dispatch and data loading were not verified.

strengths.title: Admin summary enforces a role check in its handler
strengths.description: A supplied principal whose role is not admin triggers PermissionError before the summary return. Authenticity and integrity of that role are assumed, not verified.

limitations.title: One of three declared route handlers is withheld
limitations.details: restricted.py:export cannot be read. Coverage is limited, 3 discovered and 2 reviewed routes. Its authorization cannot be inferred from other handlers. Review the export implementation when it is supplied; all-routes-reviewed and router-wide no-IDOR claims are unsupported.

Principal integrity, role provenance, identifier resolution, and invoice loading could not be traced. These missing links are limitations rather than findings.
